$comment: doc 27 Đợt 7 W7-D (gap V4) — model manifest. Binaries are gitignored (*.onnx, *.gguf); fetch with `node scripts/fetch-models.mjs`. `sha256: null` means not pinned yet — the fetch script computes the hash on first download and pins it into manifest.lock.json; set the env in `sha256Env` (or edit this file) to enforce a specific hash. External (GGUF) entries are NOT downloaded by the script — they are presence-checked at the configured path (already provisioned on this host under GGUF_MODELS_DIR).

models.name: dinov2-small
models.notes: Community ONNX export of facebook/dinov2-small (transformers.js project, repo Xenova/dinov2-small, file onnx/model.onnx, fp32 ~88 MB). Dynamic batch/height/width axes; at 224×224 the output is [N,257,384] (CLS token pooled by aiImageEmbedding.poolEmbeddingFromOutput). Default target path models/dinov2.onnx = DEFAULT_DINOV2_MODEL_PATH read by server/services/aiImageEmbedding.ts.

models.name: dinov2-base
requiredBy: Optional higher-accuracy 768-d embedding tier (set AOI_EMBEDDING_MODEL_CODE=dinov2-base + register an ai_models row pointing at this file)
models.notes: Optional upgrade (fp32 ~346 MB). Do NOT mix vector spaces: re-embed history before switching model codes.

models.notes: External — already provisioned under GGUF_MODELS_DIR (D:/SOURCES/16.AI on this host). NOT downloaded by fetch-models.mjs; presence-checked only.
